hippocratic-bedside-diagnosis.description: An older bearded, balding man with bare shoulders and a dark grey draped cloth sits on the edge of a wooden bed. He grips a younger man's wrist with one hand while the other hand rests near the patient's chest. The young man lies on pale linen with eyes closed. A clay jug, a bowl and a lit oil lamp sit on a low wooden stool, in a dim stone room with a small wall niche. The painting is dark and oil-like, with no visible text or frame.

herophilus-pulse-timing.description: Painted interior scene. A bearded man in a brown draped tunic sits on a low wooden stool, holding the wrist and open hand of a pale-robed woman who reclines or sits on the left, with her eyes half closed. Behind them is a dark stone wall with shelves holding rolled scrolls, bottles and a jug. On the right a lit candle stands beside a brass bowl on a small wooden table, and a larger brass vessel above drips water into it. The lighting is dim and warm, with no visible frame or text.

wang-shuhe-pulse-classic.description: A bearded man with a topknot, in a grey robe, sits at a wooden table in a dark room, pressing two fingers onto a seated younger person's outstretched wrist. A candle flame glows at the left edge. A small cushion sits under the wrist, a brush and ink stone lie on the table, a bundle of bamboo slips is unrolled beside them, and a ceramic jar and bowl sit at the right. The painting is an oil-style scene with no visible text, no frame and no blood.

santorio-body-thermometer.description: A bearded man in a dark robe with a white ruff leans over a table, pointing at a tall thin glass tube standing in a round flask of water. Across the table a pale, older seated woman in dark clothes holds a glass bulb to her mouth. A lit candle, shelves of books and glass vessels fill the dim background. Dark oil-painting style, edge to edge, no visible text.

leeuwenhoek-blood-cells.description: A man in a dark, plain coat and white collar leans toward a window, holding a small brass instrument to his eye. Beside him, a pale circle shows many rounded pinkish-brown discs scattered across a light background. The room has a dark wooden table with papers, a glass flask, and a window with a leaded pane grid on the right. The scene is painted in an oil-painting style with dim, warm light.

auenbrugger-chest-percussion.description: A man with grey powdered wig and dark brown 18th-century coat with a white cravat leans over a seated shirtless man, his right hand resting on the patient's bare upper back and his head bent low. The patient's white shirt is pulled down around his waist and he looks down. Behind them is a dark wood-panelled room with a desk on the right holding books and papers. Warm candlelight-style lighting falls on the skin. No visible text, frame or border.

bozzini-light-conductor.description: A man with a receding dark hairline and a dark coat with a high white collar presses one eye to a silver-and-brass lantern that holds a lit candle. A slender metal tube extends from the lantern toward the lower left. Behind him are old leather-bound books and glass flasks on a wooden table, in a dim, dark-brown room. The painting is oil-like, fills the whole square, and has no visible text or border.

riva-rocci-blood-pressure-cuff.description: A close-up oil painting of a man in a dark Victorian-style suit wrapping a cloth cuff around the bare upper arm of a shirtless man, squeezing a rubber bulb connected by tubing to a vertical mercury gauge on a small stand. A candle and bottles sit on a table in a dim room. The gauge has a faint scale with tiny tick numbers. Full bleed, no frame.

berger-eeg-recorded.description: A painted scene in dark, warm tones. A man in a waistcoat and rolled white sleeves leans in to fit small metal electrodes to the scalp of a young man seated in a wooden chair in a dim workshop. Trailing black wires run from the electrodes to a brass-and-black drum recording instrument on the right, which feeds out a long paper strip covered in wavy, handwriting-like marks. Glass jars sit on shelves behind. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame.

papanicolaou-smear-test.description: A brass laboratory microscope with a dark body stands on a wooden desk in a dim room, lit by a lamp at upper left. Beside it are small wooden boxes, a dropper bottle, and glass slides laid in a row, plus a handwritten paper at lower left. A bright circular inset above shows a field of pink and blue stained cells, with one darker purple cluster of misshapen cells at its centre. The style is an oil painting, edge to edge, with no frame.

forssmann-heart-catheter.description: A painting in dark, oil-like brushwork. Center-left, a backlit chest X-ray on a light box shows the ribcage, spine and a thin pale line curving down through the chest. Two dark silhouetted hands hold the edges of the film. In the foreground a stainless steel tray holds a coiled red-brown tube, with a syringe, small glass vials and forceps on the table beside it. Only the dim edge of the light box and the film's dark rim appear, with no text or signature visible.

apgar-score-newborns.description: A crying newborn lies on a metal tray under a dark, moody lamp. A gloved hand, cuff of a green-grey surgical gown, reaches in and holds the baby's tiny fist. A white cloth drapes the baby's hips. Behind are a small dial box, bottles and dim equipment in a dark room. The painting is an oil-style image that fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

hirschowitz-fibre-optic-endoscope.description: A painted still life in warm, dark tones. A long, flexible tube coils in loops across a dark table, with a glowing orange tip at one end and a splayed bundle of glowing fibres at the other. Behind it sit a brass microscope, glassware and an open wooden case holding instruments. A metal optical eyepiece with knobs lies in the lower right. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the square.

first-ct-scan-patient.description: A dim, painterly interior with warm amber light and cluttered shelves of old electronics with dials, meters and tangled cables. A boxy grey machine with a circular opening stands on the left, and a person in dark clothing stands beside it. A patient lies on a padded table, draped in a pale sheet, head toward the opening. On the right, a boxy CRT monitor on a cart shows a grey cross-section of a brain. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

home-pregnancy-test-launched.description: A painted still life of a bathroom shelf in warm, dim light. An open silver case with a round mirror and a small test tube in a stand sits at the centre, with a glass dropper lying across the shelf and a small glass vial at the left edge. Behind it an open cardboard box with cut compartments, a tiled wall and a patterned wallpaper panel, and a roll of tissue on the floor at the bottom. No people, no visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

first-mri-human-scan.description: A large ring-shaped metal magnet, wrapped in copper coils and bolted to a cylindrical tank on top, sits in a dim workshop-like room. A flat metal patient platform extends toward the open bore. Cables run across the frame and benches with tools line the background. No people, no visible text.

first-hiv-blood-test.description: A painterly, dark-toned scene. A gloved hand holds a pipette above a clear plastic multi-well plate, with an amber liquid being dispensed into the wells. Behind it, several blood bags hang from a metal stand on the right, with dark red blood and tubing. A second gloved hand rests at the lower right on the bench. Beakers, test tubes in a rack and glassware sit in the shadowy background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

fmri-brain-imaging.description: A painted, dark-toned brain shown in side profile sits in front of a circular machine bore with a glowing ring. Several spots on the cortex glow orange-red, as if active. Thin translucent horizontal rings wrap around the brain, and small panel markings appear on the scanner's side edges. The background is near-black with visible brushwork, and the image fills the frame edge to edge.

capsule-endoscopy-camera-pill.description: A painting of a small transparent cylindrical capsule with a lens and ring of white LEDs at one end, resting on the tip of a human thumb. The capsule's internal components are visible through the clear shell. The background is a near-black dark brown, and the thumb and hand are lit warmly from the left. There is no visible text, frame or border, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

smartwatch-ecg-approved.description: A painted close-up, in an oil-painting style, of an older person's hands. A rectangular silver-cased smartwatch sits on the left wrist, and its dark screen shows a glowing green-and-yellow heartbeat trace. A fingertip from the other hand rests near the watch's side button. The background is dark brown with loose brushwork, and a grey-brown sleeve sits at the lower left. I see no visible text, frame, blood or nudity.

mass-covid-testing.description: A painted night scene in heavy rain under sodium street lights. A health worker in a dark gown, face shield and mask leans toward a car window, holding a swab up toward a driver's face. A line of cars with headlights on stretches back past an olive-green canvas tent with a lit interior and orange traffic cones. Edge to edge painting, no visible text.
